notes.content:
Updating levels, with the addition of new moving obstacles.
Adding new levels up to 71.

notes.title: Landing point
notes.content: Landing point. indicates at what point above the surface you are. Allows you to better control the character.

notes.title: Leaderboard
notes.content: Adding a leaderboard. New time counting system with millisecond precision.

notes.title: Ghost of best time
notes.content:
Ghost of best time will show the path of your best run. The ghost is translucent and does not affect the gameplay in any way. You can disable the option in the settings.
[previewyoutube=SdQ2ruciWfw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Chapter two − New game mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rROG7kp3DZw;full][/previewyoutube]

Update add a new second chapter of levels with [b]New game mode.[/b]

In the update: new mechanics and obstacles, lasers, enemies, buttons trigger mechanisms, disappearing and rotating platforms. The level design has become more complex to reach the final you need to investigate levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39434655/dbf5749efc8d468fa14b5f3f5158d30dc5183a2d.jpg[/img]

Collecting crystals gives strength to pass puzzles and obstacles and does not affect the final goal.
To pass new levels, you just need to reach the portal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39434655/d9af3e1c30e5ba189d1601868c83109f2f14e8b3.jpg[/img]
